query: Which data-management repositories, metadata schemas, and embargo/curation policies are standard for archaeometallurgy and local stewardship?

response.query: Which data-management repositories, metadata schemas, and embargo/curation policies are standard for archaeometallurgy and local stewardship?
response.answer: Archaeometallurgical data is managed via repositories like the Integrated Earth Data Applications (IEDA), and metadata follows standards set by the Geological Society of America. Embargoes and curation policies are typically local and project-specific.

results.title: Data Policy
results.content: The Geological Society of America (GSA) supports the preservation of geoscience data for the public good and. (See GSA’s Position Statements on Data. Access and Geoscience Data Preservation.). GSA requires authors to follow established community standards for archiving specific types of data (see, for. example, Deines et al., 2003; Renne et al., 2009; Schmitz, 2012, for standards of archiving radiogenic isotope. data; see Schaen et al., 2021, for information on reporting 40Ar/39Ar geochronologic.
